input.summary: Add Customer affiliate/successor assignment carve-out and bar assignment to a Company competitor
input.comment: [Playbook] We added the customary carve-out allowing Company to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, and confirmed Contractor may not assign to a Company competitor. Our playbook requires corporate reorganisations and M&A not to be blocked by a consent right; if helpful, we can accept a mutual successor-assignment right on written notice instead.

ops.oldText: without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: without the other party's express, prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld; provided that Company may assign this Agreement, without consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, and Contractor shall not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Company.
